value.rationale: Logical depth is a standard descriptive-complexity invariant and complete multipartite graphs are a canonical class with large similarity classes. An exact criterion for every heterogeneous part multiset gives a natural complete classification, recovers important subfamilies, and is algorithmically usable in linear time in the number of distinct part sizes.
